_about: The framework items this lab maps to. Texts are short forms; open the source for the full wording. Checked 24 Oct 2026.

nist_ai_rmf.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1, Jan 2023) subcategories

items.GOVERN 1.1: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented.
items.GOVERN 1.4: The risk management process and its outcomes are established through transparent policies and procedures.
items.GOVERN 1.5: Ongoing monitoring and periodic review of the risk management process and its outcomes are planned.
items.GOVERN 1.6: Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems and are resourced according to organizational risk priorities.
items.GOVERN 2.1: Roles, responsibilities and lines of communication for mapping, measuring and managing AI risks are documented and clear.
items.GOVERN 4.3: Organizational practices are in place to enable AI testing, identification of incidents, and information sharing.
items.GOVERN 6.1: Policies and procedures are in place that address AI risks associated with third-party entities.
items.GOVERN 6.2: Contingency processes are in place to handle failures or incidents in third-party data or AI systems.
items.MAP 1.1: Intended purposes, beneficial uses, context-specific laws, norms and expectations are understood and documented.
items.MAP 1.5: Organizational risk tolerances are determined and documented.
items.MAP 3.5: Processes for human oversight are defined, assessed, and documented.
items.MAP 4.1: Approaches for mapping AI technology and legal risks of its components are in place and followed.
items.MAP 5.1: Likelihood and magnitude of each identified impact are identified and documented.
items.MEASURE 1.1: Approaches and metrics for measuring the AI risks enumerated in MAP are selected for implementation.
items.MEASURE 2.3: AI system performance or assurance criteria are measured and demonstrated.
items.MEASURE 2.4: The functionality and behavior of the AI system and its components are monitored when in production.
items.MEASURE 2.7: AI system security and resilience, as identified in the MAP function, are evaluated and documented.
items.MEASURE 2.8: Risks associated with transparency and accountability are examined and documented.
items.MEASURE 2.10: Privacy risk of the AI system, as identified in the MAP function, is examined and documented.
items.MANAGE 1.2: Treatment of documented AI risks is prioritized based on impact, likelihood, and available resources or methods.
items.MANAGE 1.3: Responses to high-priority AI risks are developed, planned, and documented (mitigate, transfer, avoid or accept).
items.MANAGE 1.4: Negative residual risks to downstream acquirers and end users are documented.
items.MANAGE 2.3: Procedures are followed to respond to and recover from a previously unknown risk when it is identified.
items.MANAGE 2.4: Mechanisms are in place to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems whose outcomes are inconsistent with intended use.
items.MANAGE 3.1: AI risks and benefits from third-party resources are regularly monitored, and risk controls are applied and documented.
items.MANAGE 4.1: Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented.
items.MANAGE 4.2: Measurable activities for continual improvements are integrated into AI system updates.
items.MANAGE 4.3: Incidents and errors are communicated to relevant AI actors, including affected communities.
